metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows a modified figure 4 stretch (aka pigeon pose) that can offer a deep stretch into the glutes and piriformis muscles.

This exercise can be done at home, requires no equipment, and can give quick hip pain relief... even within seconds.

Let us know how it works for you!
